tagline: The newest district and the gateway landscape between Assam and Nagaland hills
description: Chumoukedima is Nagaland's newest district, carved from Dimapur in 2024. It lies directly adjacent to Dimapur and serves as the transitional zone between Assam's plains and Nagaland's hills. The district includes part of the landscape that visitors pass through on the Guwahati-Dimapur-Kohima route. Minimal tourism infrastructure but good location for a quick stop.
incitetales_angle: Chumoukedima is the edge of Nagaland — where the plains meet the hills. Few tourists think of it as a destination, but it marks the beginning of the state.

destinations.name: Chumoukedima
destinations.tagline: The entry town to Nagaland's hill landscape
destinations.description: Chumoukedima is a growing town, the newest district headquarters. It sits between the plains and the hills. The town is more developed than typical district towns due to its proximity to Dimapur.
local_food: Mix of Assamese and Naga cuisine
local_tips: Only 20–30km from Dimapur — quick transit stop
Marks the visual entry into Nagaland's hill region
Minimal tourism — most travelers pass through without stopping

permit.notes: Technically requires ILP as part of Nagaland, though very close to Assam-Nagaland border.

from_guwahati.notes: Direct route, en route to rest of Nagaland.

from_dimapur.notes: Very quick from Dimapur — most travelers don't bother stopping.

best_season.notes: Year-round — this is a transit point, not a destination.
